passed_reason: new C2 side fails byte-exact batch-composition invariance at c2/c4 (see findings); old side passed
performance_claim_scope: same-host W7900 gfx1100 device 0, identical declared protocol, both sides measured 2026-08-19; diagnostic A/B, not a retained topline row
hardware: AMD Radeon Pro W7900 gfx1100, device 0 (48 GiB), therock env

protocol.timing_boundary: SSE client cycle wall, simultaneous release to last completed response, generated-token numerator

old_side.tree: /tmp/qwen38-oldg1 @ b08ed12d6 (pre-C2 main, last state of the old design for this model)
old_side.policy: protect_ttft (F1 harness default; the old tree's scoped factory default for gfx1100 gguf_q4_k_m was fair:256/burst-1 - both pre-C2 policies form the same native_packed_decode batches on this model; route counters confirm 889 packed decode steps per measured set)

new_side.result_status: failed_exception at c8 (unsupported width); c1/c2/c4 rows recorded with mismatches

new_c2.detail: HTTP 400: qmicro planar rowtile requires rows in [2, 4]

findings.claim: Neither design scales concurrency for Qwen3.8-27B on W7900: packed c2/c4 decode costs ~5x the c1 per-step time (ITL p50 36ms c1 vs 184ms c2 / 198ms c4) in BOTH trees, so aggregate tok/s DROPS from c1 to c2 (23.2 -> ~10.1) and only partially recovers at c4 (~17.6).
findings.interpretation: Model-specific (dense 27B, weight-bandwidth-bound; the 35B-A3B MoE packed path scales 1.68x at c8 on the same C2 tree). Pre-dates C2 - identical collapse in the pre-C2 tree. Not a C2 regression; a packed-kernel inefficiency for this model shape ('qmicro planar rowtile' family) that neither design has resolved.

findings.claim: The new C2 tree is NOT byte-exact vs the c1 oracle at c2/c4 for this model: prompt row 2 (sha256 21bb8bca...) matches through decode token 73 then emits 6866 where the c1 oracle emits 3154 (c2: 4/6 exact, c4: 11/12 exact; deterministic across runs).
findings.evidence: new side measured mismatches first_mismatch_index=73 expected=3154 observed=6866; old side (same host/protocol/model) is 6/6 and 12/12 exact
findings.interpretation: Batch-composition invariance is a first-class gate; the pre-C2 packed path was invariant for this model, the C2 packed path is not. Candidate root causes: C2 packed-KV/workspace changes (af5d00098 workspace leases, 29a786afc page-aware packed KV copies). Requires fixture isolation and bisection; the packed route for this model must either be fixed to strict parity or the route must fail closed to the serial c1 fallback.

findings.claim: Physical c8 is unavailable for this model on gfx1100 in both designs: new tree rejects rows>4 (qmicro planar rowtile requires rows in [2,4]); old tree registry cap is 4.

limitations: Old side used protect_ttft (harness default) rather than the old tree's fair scoped default; both policies form the same packed batches here (route counters), and the fair-launch W7900 measurement (2026-08-16) recorded the same flat packed behavior.
Synthetic token-ID prompts (512x token 9707 with 4 prompt rows); the diverging row is the one that generates varied tokens before converging to the repeat.
Single host (W7900 device 0); XTX/gfx1151 Qwen3.8 numbers are a different lane and are not mixed in.
